method: Actual source audit and personal inspection of all eight fixed exact-GLB final views; no exhaustive triangle-intersection solver claim.
observation: All eight exact final views inspected. The broad irregular naked-axis tuft, upper dichotomies, compact basal branching, short descending root-like axes, and loose lateral capsules are visible in the front/side/hero/clay views; top shows true branching, not a flat billboard. Capsule notches and very short stalks are small at512px and require source inspection or closer viewing; they are not claimed as independently resolved in every frame. Primary branch/capsule counts are explicit low-poly reductions from the fossil estimate. No foliage, flowers, modern leaves, dense terminal strobili, or soil pedestal were added. The root morphology is an inferred reconstruction, not a claim of preserved root caps/hairs. Central branch joins are intentional non-coplanar intersections, not a printable Boolean union.
limitations: Closed meshes do not certify watertight Boolean unions, printability, all intersections, or independent acceptance.
